evidence: Dropdowns don't open with Enter key
user_impact: Keyboard-only users cannot access sub-menus without a mouse
recommended_fix: Add keydown event listener for Enter/Space on dropdown toggles

user_impact: Screen reader users do not know what data to enter in the inputs
recommended_fix: Add explicit <label for="id"> elements for all form inputs

user_impact: Low vision users cannot read the banner text clearly
recommended_fix: Darken the text color to meet the minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio

user_impact: Visually impaired users don't know the link's destination
recommended_fix: Add descriptive alt text like alt="Facebook Page" to images

evidence: Focus stays on background when modal opens
user_impact: Keyboard focus is lost navigating the background instead of the popup
recommended_fix: Use JavaScript to trap focus inside the modal when it opens
